key_insight: VoroTypes automatically enumerates all Voronoi cell topologies that a crystal can adopt under small perturbations, enabling robust structural identification for complex crystals beyond simple reference lattices.
engineering_relevance: It expands atomistic simulation analysis to complex phases like Frank–Kasper and Laves structures, with per-sublattice resolution and direct use in VoroTop or OVITO workflows.
method: Takes a CIF or POSCAR crystal description as input.
Uses exact symmetry reduction to cut redundant cases during enumeration.
Applies validity pruning to discard impossible Voronoi topologies and exports the result as a VoroTop filter.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a library of precomputed filters covering over a thousand Materials Project structures, indicating broad evaluated coverage rather than a single-case demo.
watch_item: Results depend on the quality of the crystallographic input and the assumptions of small generic perturbations, so edge cases with strong disorder or defective structures may need manual validation.
paper_title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
